snippet.title: BOARDING DENIED - Gameplay | The world ends in 12 days
snippet.description:
BOARDING DENIED gameplay. November 2041: the Wormwood meteorite hits in 12 days. You are the clerk at Boarding Window 7. Check the papers and stamp BOARD or DENIED. Every stamp is a life.

Get it on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pigeong.boardingdenied
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/10021101
